test_title: PYST 1: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 24 Jul, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Arrange the sentences correctly:
(1) He packed his bag.
(2) He boarded the train.
(3) He reached the station.
(4) He left for his trip.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sequence of events must follow the logical order of actions taken during the trip.
 
• **Sentence 1:** "He packed his bag" is the first step as packing is done before leaving for a trip.
 
• **Sentence 3:** "He reached the station" comes next since traveling to the station is the logical next step after packing.
 
• **Sentence 2:** "He boarded the train" follows once he is at the station and ready to depart.
 
• **Sentence 4:** "He left for his trip" is the final action as it signifies the departure from the station.
 
• The correct sequence of sentences is **1-3-2-4**.

 

**Coherent sequence after rearrangement**:

"He packed his bag. He reached the station. He boarded the train. He left for his trip."</div
